name: fhsw-arnhem-coop-rec
description: Forgotten Hope: Secret Weapons Arnhem-1944 co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only. FHSW's init.con adds FH and Bf1942 archive paths, so the lab needs both `lab.py setup --mods-from-client FHSW FH`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let the round run to its end (or 20 min), then `lab.py stop`.
